patch.value: pm CLI 2026.9.11 drops every pm-ops command, because its new core ops group collides at group level

Measured 2026-09-12 while certifying pm CLI 2026.9.12. From 2026.9.11, pm-cli registers a core ops command group (stats, health, validate, gc, telemetry, eval, test-all), and extension collision is decided per group, not per leaf. All ten pm-ops commands (ops audit, docstrings, merge-receipts, metrics, outdated, policy, report, scan, status, verify-release) are dropped with extension_command_collision and core command preserved, although none of those leaves exists in core. Reproduced by installing this package into a fresh project: pm ops metrics prints usage on 2026.9.10 and fails with Unknown command metrics on 2026.9.11 and 2026.9.12. The package test 'installed pm CLI routes --repos values to every fleet command' fails on 2026.9.12 for exactly this reason. Library consumers that import pm-ops/attestation are unaffected, so the fleet's release gates keep working; the pm command surface is what breaks. Filed upstream as unbraind/pm-cli#1249.

Either pm-cli ships leaf-level collision detection, so pm ops metrics works with pm-ops installed on a CLI that has the core ops group, and this repository then certifies that CLI with its routing test passing unchanged; or pm-ops moves its commands to a namespace core does not own, with a documented migration path and the routing test updated to the new paths
Waiting on unbraind/pm-cli#1249: leaf-level extension collision under core command groups
